item.title: Evening Weather for Tuesday, September 01
item.description: Good evening! Here is your weather report for Tuesday, September 1. It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Today in Shanghai, it will be drizzly. It will reach 30 degrees, and drop down to 25 degrees. Rain is about 77 percent likely today. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! As for tomorrow, expect it to be thundery, with a high of 28 degrees. Here's a question: what is the best thing about today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
